maxVersionNote: 0.1.0 reads the type and shape tokens (--ds-weight-*, --ds-btn-radius, --ds-card-radius, --ds-input-radius, --ds-media-radius) and every colour role systems define in src/styles/tokens.css and global.css, with the template value as the fallback; src/lib/ds-slot.ts and the layout load data/ds-slot.css as in Tracy Base.
applies: data/ds-slot.css read per request by src/lib/ds-slot.ts; the template reads every value as var(--ds-*, <its own value>)
readsRolesNote: src/styles/tokens.css and global.css read every standard role variable, or declare it unused with a reason; the type and shape tokens are read with the template's own value as the fallback
modesNote: the light/dark switch (data-theme on html, [data-theme-toggle] in Header.astro)

contrast.heading: body :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)
contrast.text: body :is(p, li, a, span, small, label, td, th, dd, dt, blockquote, figcaption, button)
contrast.block-text: body div:not(:has(> :is(div, p, ul, ol, section, article, header, footer, nav, main, aside, figure, table, form, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)))

readyNote: not measured yet: flow.mjs --cms emdash has not been run on a site built from the 0.1.0 release; the measurement goes to contracts/0.1.0/design-system-measurement.json and this row flips to true after it passes
measureNote: Carousels (the home hero and the text slider) are stopped on their first slide before each measure
paletteKeepNote: The scrims over the news and latest-post pictures are neutral black layers over a photograph: a system does not repaint them.
